body:
Full-codebase review, Android finding. Verified by reading.

`ListScreen`'s group header key is `"header-${group.category ?: "—"}"`, and `CategoryCanon.UNCATEGORIZED_LABEL` is the same em dash, which a user can also type as a category name. A list holding one item categorised "—" and one uncategorised produces two groups with the same key, and Compose throws `IllegalArgumentException: Key "header-—" was already used` — the screen crashes and stays crashed until the data changes.

Fix direction: key on the canonical category with a distinct sentinel for uncategorised.
title: Android: an item categorised with an em dash crashes the list screen on a duplicate key
